metadata.description: A self-improving dev loop harness: verifier=ceiling + verified-lessons memory, split into focused plugins instead of one monolith.

plugins.name: loop-engine
plugins.description: Core loop mechanics: verdict-run (machine-readable PASS/FAIL contract), loop-fix (closed verify->fix loop), lessons (verified-fix memory), classify-risk, require-tests. No framework opinions beyond "the verifier is the ceiling, never the agent's self-report".

plugins.name: ship-flow
plugins.description: Delivery-loop skills (hotfix so far — ship-feature/retrospect/grill-with-docs to follow) parameterized by a consuming repo's own tracker/branch-model config instead of hardcoded to one repo. dependencies: loop-engine.
